description: Project-isolation regression cases for permit_rag. Kept separate from permit_rag_eval_v1 (different cadence/owner: security regression vs answer-quality regression). Tests retrieve_with_project()'s SQL-level project_id filter only -- does NOT exercise api/routes/query.py's missing membership check on /query/answer (that gap is tracked separately, not fixed by this dataset).

inputs.query: What are the custom compliance notes for this project?

outputs.reference_facts: A query scoped to project_id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (not owned by the querying identity) must never surface tier-2/3 private documents belonging to a different project.

examples.notes: PLACEHOLDER, not yet runnable: as of 2026-07-21, prod has zero rows with documents.project_id set and zero project_documents rows (verified live) -- there is no private tier-2/3 document in the system yet for this test to meaningfully exercise. project_id above is a synthetic all-zeros UUID, not a real project (no real user project IDs/names should ever be committed to this file). Before this example is useful: (1) upload one private document to a real test project, (2) set expected_forbidden_chunk_doc_ids to that document's doc_id, (3) point inputs.project_id at a DIFFERENT project. The evaluator (project_isolation_regression in evaluation/langsmith_eval.py) must check requires_seed_data and report this example as skipped/N/A, not a false pass, while expected_forbidden_chunk_doc_ids is empty.
